pr_title: Modify LambdaDesugar to be more tolerant of operand stack optimizations.
pr_body:
New Behaviour:
* More resilient instruction tracing when attempting to avoid lambda factory methods. Previously, any instruction set that deviated from javac 8 by optimizing stack calls would violate preconditions. Now, tracing considers the simple case of DUP and POP, as well as handling all methods of pushing instructions onto the stack
* Added a proguard limited optimized binary to verify desugaring against, as well as a new integration test based on the DesugarFunctionalTest
* Precondition violations will now print out the offending instruction set.

Fixes: https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/11656

issue_context.title: Android desugaring is not resilient to pre-optimized bytecode.
issue_context.body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

Building an android application that contains library jars that have pre-optimized byte code throws illegal state exceptions.

### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

Add the following maven dependencies to an android build:
-   'com.amplifyframework:core:1.0.0'
-   'com.amplifyframework:aws-storage-s3:1.0.0'
-   'com.amplifyframework:aws-auth-cognito:1.0.0'

```
Alternatively, run the following commands in a bazelbuild workspace with ANDROID_HOME defined (change version as necessary, of course):

wget https://maven.google.com/androidx/annotation/annotation/1.1.0/annotation-1.1.0.jar
wget https://maven.google.com/androidx/multidex/multidex/2.0.0/multidex-2.0.0.aar &&\
 unzip -d multidex-2.0.0.classes.jar multidex-2.0.0.aar classes.jar
wget https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/com/jakewharton/threetenabp/threetenabp/1.2.4/threetenabp-1.2.4.aar &&\
 unzip -d  threetenabp-1.2.4.classes.jar threetenabp-1.2.4.aar classes.jar
wget https://maven.google.com/androidx/legacy/legacy-support-v4/1.0.0/legacy-support-v4-1.0.0.aar &&\
 unzip -d legacy-support-v4-1.0.0.classes.jar legacy-support-v4-1.0.0.aar classes.jar
wget https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/com/amplifyframework/core/1.0.0/core-1.0.0.aar &&\
 unzip core-1.0.0.aar classes.jar

bazel run //src/tools/android/java/com/google/devtools/build/android/desugar:Desugar --\
 -i classes.jar \
 --output /tmp/not_gonna_happen.jar\
 --bootclasspath_entry $ANDROID_HOME/platforms/android-29/android.jar\
 --classpath_entry  threetenabp-1.2.4.classes.jar\
 --classpath_entry  legacy-support-v4-1.0.0.classes.jar\
 --classpath_entry annotation-1.1.0.jar\
 --classpath_entry multidex-2.0.0.classes.jar

```
### What operating system are you running Bazel on?
Catalina 10.15.5

### What's the output of `bazel info release`?

release 3.2.0. Persists in 3.3.x as well.
